## Source availability

No `source/exporter/` directory was supplied, so there is no first-party
source or decompiled code for the exporter. Everything below is read from
`Barsa.Meta.DataExchange.dll` metadata and IL.

This matters: it caps the exporter findings at **Observed** for behaviour,
even where the API surface itself is **Verified**.

## Obfuscation

Private and internal members of this assembly are renamed. The public surface
above is complete and real; the internals behind it are opaque. Any claim about
*how* a step works internally would be a guess, and is therefore recorded as
Unknown.
